reviewed_by: Codex source/diff/original requirement and bounded inline diagnostic review 2026-10-25
review_notes: Class access returns the actual cachedproperty descriptor; instance access invokes its wrapped function with that instance, then caches the result on that instance. The primary contract is descriptor binding, not cache eviction. Adjacent duplicate cachedproperty implementations are one family, not extra examples. Source Smith patch introduces the defect. Original required lists/full-file scope preserved; baseline diagnostic error is expected reproduction, not a policy failure.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib, sys, pytest
module=importlib.import_module('boltons.cacheutils')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd()/'boltons/cacheutils.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'Python',sys.version.split()[0],'pytest',pytest.__version__)
from boltons.cacheutils import cachedproperty
class Probe:
 def __init__(self,value):
  self.value=value; self.calls=0
 @cachedproperty
 def payload(self):
  self.calls += 1
  return self.value,self
p=Probe(7)
descriptor=vars(Probe)['payload']
class_access=Probe.payload
try:
 first=p.payload; second=p.payload
 observed=(first[0],first[1] is p,second is first,p.calls)
except Exception as exc:
 observed=type(exc).__name__,str(exc)
print('descriptor_class_identity',class_access is descriptor,'instance_binding_and_cache',observed)
assert class_access is descriptor
assert observed==(7,True,True,1)
q=Probe(11)
assert q.payload==(11,q) and q.calls==1 and p.calls==1
print('class_instance_descriptor_contract',True)
PYREPLAY
